data.name: Ibrahimov
data.gender_notes: Ibrahimov is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ibrahimov is a patronymic name derived from Ibrahim, meaning 'father of many' in Arabic. In Islamic tradition, Ibrahim is revered as a patriarch and a symbol of faith. The name Ibrahimov carries the meaning “Father of many” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ibrahimov usually hope their child will grow to embody father of many and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Patron of the faithful, symbol of faith and devotion
data.etymology: Ibrahimov belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father of many.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ibrahimov total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

It symbolizes the unwavering faith and trust in God's promise, which has been upheld throughout history. The name Ibrahimov embodies the qualities of perseverance, loyalty, and devotion, making it a popular choice among Muslims worldwide.
